author: Auhsoj
quote: Ocarina of Time was already one of the greatest video games ever made, and having played the original countless times over the years, experiencing it again in this beautiful new format is something truly special. The presentation is unbelievably beautiful, breathing new life into a game that was already magical.There are certain works of art you return to throughout your life, not because you need to experience something new, but because they’re simply that good. For me, The Lord of the Rings is one of those experiences, something I rewatch every year. Ocarina of Time occupies that same special place in gaming.Some games are more than entertainment. They’re timeless experiences that never lose their magic. Ocarina of Time is one of them, and I’m so happy to have another reason to revisit this masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Auhsoj
quote: I find it genuinely disheartening to see GTA VI become such a massive cultural phenomenon. My concern isn’t simply that it’s a violent video game, but what its popularity represents about modern ****’ve become so accustomed to celebrating graphic violence, sexual content, drug use, and criminal behavior as entertainment that questioning it gets you labeled overly sensitive or out of touch.I’m not suggesting video games turn people into criminals, but pretending that repeated exposure to this material has absolutely no influence, particularly on younger audiences, is equally unreasonable.I also question why content of this nature warrants a Mature 17+ rating rather than Adults Only.Video games have the potential to celebrate imagination, creativity, exploration, meaningful storytelling, and artistic expression. I’d much rather see those qualities celebrated than the endless glorification of violence and excess.Popularity doesn’t automatically equal cultural value, and commercial success shouldn’t put legitimate criticism off-limits.
